question: What is the clinical term for heartburn?
explanation: Pyrosis is simply the medical word for that burning feeling in your chest caused by stomach acid splashing up. You've got this! [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h1)

question: During which stage of pregnancy does heartburn usually act up the most?
explanation: As the baby grows big and cozy in the third trimester, it pushes right up against the stomach, making acid reflux much more common. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h1)

question: Which pregnancy hormone is mainly responsible for relaxing the valve between the stomach and food pipe?
explanation: Progesterone relaxes smooth muscles all over the body to make room for baby, which also loosens the sphincter keeping stomach acid down. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h2)

question: How does a growing uterus directly cause acid reflux in expectant mothers?

options.A: By pushing the stomach upward and increasing pressure
options.B: By causing the liver to produce more digestive enzymes
options.C: By tightening the muscular walls of the esophagus
options.D: By increasing the total volume of stomach acid produced

explanation: Think of space issues! The growing womb crowds the belly and literally squeezes the stomach upward, pushing contents toward the throat. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h2)

question: What common mouth symptom often tags along with pregnancy heartburn?

options.A: A metallic taste from iron deficiency
options.C: Numbness of the tongue and gums
options.D: A sour or bitter taste in the mouth

explanation: When acid travels up the esophagus, it reaches the mouth and leaves behind a very unpleasant sour or bitter taste. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h3)

question: Which sleeping or resting position is most likely to make heartburn worse for an expectant mother?
explanation: Lying flat takes away gravity's help, making it super easy for stomach acid to flow right back up. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h3)

question: A pregnant patient reports severe chest pain spreading down her left arm. What should the nurse do first?

options.A: Report it immediately for cardiac evaluation
options.B: Suggest she take a strong antacid tablet right away
options.C: Reassure her that this is normal third-trimester heartburn
options.D: Advise her to lie down and drink cold milk

explanation: Chest pain spreading to the arm is a red flag for the heart! Never brush it off as simple heartburn. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h4)

question: Which of these is NOT a normal sign of simple pregnancy heartburn?

options.A: Worsening discomfort after eating a large meal
options.B: A sour taste at the back of the throat
options.C: A burning feeling behind the breastbone
options.D: Crushing chest pain radiating to the jaw

explanation: Crushing jaw pain points toward heart trouble, not regular acid reflux. Good clinical spotting! [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h4)

question: A pregnant woman complains of terrible night heartburn. What easy adjustment can the nurse suggest for bedtime?

options.A: Elevate the head of the bed by several inches
options.B: Sleep lying flat on her right side with no pillows
options.C: Sleep flat on her stomach with a pillow under her hips
options.D: Use extra heavy blankets to keep the abdomen warm

explanation: Propping up the head of the bed uses gravity to keep stomach acid where it belongs while she sleeps. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h5)

question: Why do we advise pregnant mothers to eat small, frequent meals instead of three massive plates of food?

options.A: To prevent sudden drops in blood sugar during the afternoon
options.B: To speed up the absorption of prenatal vitamins into the bloodstream
options.C: To prevent the stomach from becoming overly full and putting pressure on the sphincter
options.D: To stop the liver from producing excess bile during digestion

explanation: Smaller meals keep tummy pressure low, stopping acid from splashing up into the food pipe. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h5)

question: When lifestyle changes don't quite cut it, what type of medication is usually recommended first for pregnancy heartburn?
explanation: Calcium and magnesium antacids work fast to neutralize acid and have a safe track record during pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h6)

question: Why should pregnant women steer clear of sodium bicarbonate for everyday heartburn?

options.A: It causes immediate and permanent closure of the esophagus
options.B: It triggers severe allergic reactions in the fetus
options.C: It completely stops the liver from filtering blood
options.D: It can cause fluid retention and electrolyte imbalances

explanation: Sodium bicarbonate has lots of salt, which can cause dangerous swelling and fluid buildup during pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h6)

question: What can happen if severe, constant pregnancy heartburn is left completely untreated?

options.A: Inflammation and damage to the lining of the esophagus
options.B: Permanent hardening of the muscular stomach walls
options.C: Complete blockage of the upper respiratory airway
options.D: Sudden loss of all maternal digestive enzymes

explanation: Constant acid wash irritates and damages the delicate lining of the food pipe over time, leading to inflammation. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h7)

question: A pregnant patient says she wants to take a random herbal remedy she saw online for her heartburn. What is the nurse's best reply?

options.A: Advise her to check with her healthcare provider first to ensure safety
options.B: Suggest she stop eating completely until the baby is born
options.C: Encourage her to take a double dose to get fast relief
options.D: Tell her that all natural herbs are completely safe in pregnancy

explanation: Always guide patients to chat with their doctor or midwife before trying unverified remedies during pregnancy. Safety first! [learn more](GNS226_U2_T013#GNS226_U2_T013_h7)
